semantics.selection: Unique exact profile/version set, UTF-8 byte sorted in binding; request and invocation identity included; no caller identity in body
semantics.authority: Current IAM direct-user proof plus current personal ownership and exact version; verify again before return. Agent also checks live run/lease/cancellation and frozen selection
semantics.material: Each execute acquires fresh erasable UTF-8 bytes. No caching, persistence, environment file, prompt, journal, command argv or global os.environ
semantics.environment: Duplicate names across all selected profiles rejected, even equal values. Runtime-control variables rejected before decryption
semantics.isolation: Only task-isolated Docker/E2B execution. No host local shell fallback. Plaintext output redaction is not a guarantee against arbitrary script exfiltration
semantics.revocation: Deleted/edited profiles or revoked secrets reject subsequent acquisition. Does not claim to revoke already executing child processes
semantics.activation: Fixed IAM operation consumer and Agent consumer, then isolated chain verification; no production activation by generation
